Image to Base64 Converter

Embed small images directly in your HTML, CSS or JSON by turning them into Base64 text. Drop an image and copy the data URI, a ready-made img tag, or CSS background code.

How to use Image to Base64 Converter

  1. Drop one or more images into the box.
  2. Choose what to copy: the data URI, an HTML img tag, CSS, or the Base64 text alone.
  3. Paste it into your code.

Frequently asked questions

When should I use Base64 images?

They suit small icons and logos because they save a network request. For larger photos, normal image files are better because Base64 adds about 33 percent to the size.

Is my image uploaded?

No. The conversion happens in your browser.
